description: This file defines the LocationDAO interface for database operations related to locations in the OpenMRS project. It declares methods for CRUD operations, searches, and retrieval of location-related entities.

classes.name: LocationDAO
classes.description: Interface for location database operations, including create, read, update, delete, and query methods.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory for database connection.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Creates or updates a Location entity.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Retrieves all locations, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations matching specified criteria, with support for filtering by name fragment, parent location, attribute values, retired status, and pagination.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Removes a Location from the database.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Retrieves all LocationTags, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Finds LocationTags matching a search string.

methods.name: deleteLocationTag
methods.description: Deletes a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Finds a Location by UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Finds a LocationTag by UUID.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching a name fragment and retired status.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Retrieves root locations, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all location attribute types.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Fetches locations that have all listed tags, ignoring nulls, returning empty list if none match.
